-- LocalScript

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- SETTINGS
local SPEED = 50
local ACCELERATION = 3
local SPIN_POWER = 1

-- HUMANOID
humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
humanoid.JumpPower = 0
humanoid.AutoRotate = false
humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)

for _, state in ipairs({
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing,
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall,
}) do
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(state, false)
end

local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
if animate then
	animate.Disabled = true
end

-- ZERO GRAVITY
local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
attachment.Name = "ZeroGravityAttachment"
attachment.Parent = root

local gravityForce = Instance.new("VectorForce")
gravityForce.Name = "ZeroGravity"
gravityForce.Attachment0 = attachment
gravityForce.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
gravityForce.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
gravityForce.Force = Vector3.new(
	0,
	root.AssemblyMass * workspace.Gravity,
	0
)
gravityForce.Parent = root

-- IDLE
local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

if animator then
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://180435571"

	local idle = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	idle.Looped = true
	idle.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
	idle:Play()
end

-- INPUT
local keys = {
	W = false,
	A = false,
	S = false,
	D = false,
	Space = false,
	Ctrl = false
}

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then keys.W = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then keys.A = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then keys.S = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then keys.D = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then keys.Space = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then keys.Ctrl = true end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then keys.W = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then keys.A = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then keys.S = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then keys.D = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then keys.Space = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then keys.Ctrl = false end
end)

-- MOVEMENT
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end

	local movement = Vector3.zero

	if keys.W then
		movement += camera.CFrame.LookVector
	end

	if keys.S then
		movement -= camera.CFrame.LookVector
	end

	if keys.D then
		movement += camera.CFrame.RightVector
	end

	if keys.A then
		movement -= camera.CFrame.RightVector
	end

	if keys.Space then
		movement += Vector3.yAxis
	end

	if keys.Ctrl then
		movement -= Vector3.yAxis
	end

	if movement.Magnitude > 0 then

		movement = movement.Unit

		local targetVelocity = movement * SPEED
		local currentVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

		-- VERY gentle control
		local difference = targetVelocity - currentVelocity
		local change = ACCELERATION * dt

		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
			currentVelocity + difference * change
	end
end)

-- RANDOM TUMBLING
task.spawn(function()

	while character.Parent do

		local randomSpin = Vector3.new(
			math.random(-100, 100) / 100,
			math.random(-100, 100) / 100,
			math.random(-100, 100) / 100
		)

		if randomSpin.Magnitude > 0.1 then
			randomSpin = randomSpin.Unit

			-- Merge with existing spin
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity +=
				randomSpin * SPIN_POWER
		end

		task.wait(math.random(60, 180) / 100)
	end
end)

local function GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer, maxAngle)
    maxAngle = maxAngle or 60

    if not targetPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return nil end

    local targetLook = targetHRP.CFrame.LookVector

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p ~= targetPlayer and p.Character then
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local difference = hrp.Position - targetHRP.Position

                    local dot = math.clamp(targetLook:Dot(vec), -1, 1)
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(dot))

                        local dist = difference.Magnitude

    end

    local function updateDrag(input)
        if not dragging or not dragStart or not startPosition then
            return
        end

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then
            return
        end

        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

        local newX = startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local newY = startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

        newX = math.clamp(
            newX,
            0,
            math.max(0, viewport.X - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X)
        )

        newY = math.clamp(
            newY,
            0,
            math.max(0, viewport.Y - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        )

        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newX, newY)
    end

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            local target = input.Target

            if target == closeBtn
                or target == guiToggle
                or target == targetBox
                or target == standBtn
                or target == punchBtn
                or target == posBox
                or target == offBox
                or target == heightBox then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragInput = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = mainFrame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                    dragInput = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput then
            updateDrag(input)
        end
    end)
end

    if not bp then
        bp = Instance.new("BodyPosition")

        bp.P = 2000
        bp.D = 50
        bp.Position = humanoidRootPart.Position
        bp.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end

    if not gyro then
        gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        gyro.P = 2000
        gyro.D = 50
        gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5)
        gyro.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
        gyro.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    end
end

    for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then

        bp = nil

    local start = tick()
    local movel = 0.1

    while tick() - start < duration do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local c = player.Character
        local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel * 10000
                + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity = vel

            RunService.Stepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel
                + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)

            movel = -movel
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local chestEnabled = false
local chestRunning = false
local npcKillEnabled = false
local autoOpenEnabled = false
local lootVacuumEnabled = false

local CHECK_DELAY = 0.4
local MAX_CHESTS = 8
local skippedPrompts = {}
local selectedChestTypes = {} 
local selectedNPCTypes = {} 
local selectedOpenTypes = {} 
local chestCache = {}

local function checkIgnore(instance)
	if not instance then return false end
	local nameLower = string.lower(instance.Name)
	if nameLower:find("world") or nameLower:find("omnius") or nameLower:find("witch") or nameLower:find("merchant") then return true end
	local current = instance.Parent
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		local pName = string.lower(current.Name)
		if pName:find("world") or pName:find("omnius") or pName:find("witch") or pName:find("merchant") then return true end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local function isChest(instance)
	if not instance then return false end
	local nameLower = string.lower(instance.Name)
	return (instance:IsA("Model") or instance:IsA("BasePart")) and (nameLower:find("chest") or nameLower:find("diamond")) and not checkIgnore(instance)
end

local function refreshChestCache()
	table.clear(chestCache)
	for _, prompt in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and prompt.Parent and isChest(prompt.Parent) then
			table.insert(chestCache, prompt)
		end
	end
end

local function getPos(prompt)
	local parent = prompt.Parent if not parent then return end
	if parent:IsA("Attachment") then return parent.WorldPosition end
	if parent:IsA("BasePart") then return parent.Position end
	if parent:IsA("Model") then return parent:GetPivot().Position end
end

local function getChests(root)
	local list, hasSelection = {}, false
	for _, v in pairs(selectedChestTypes) do if v then hasSelection = true break end end
	for _, prompt in ipairs(chestCache) do
		if prompt and prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled and not skippedPrompts[prompt] then
			if not hasSelection or selectedChestTypes[prompt.Parent.Name] then
				local pos = getPos(prompt)
				if pos then table.insert(list, {prompt = prompt, pos = pos, dist = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude}) end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
	return {unpack(list, 1, math.min(#list, MAX_CHESTS))}
end

local function collectLoop()
	if chestRunning then return end chestRunning = true
	while chestEnabled do
		task.wait(CHECK_DELAY)
		local character = player.Character 
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") 
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
			refreshChestCache()
			local targets = getChests(root)
			
			if #targets > 0 then
				local originalCFrame = root.CFrame
				local savedCollides = {}
				for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do 
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then savedCollides[part] = part.CanCollide part.CanCollide = false end 
				end
				for _, data in ipairs(targets) do
					if not chestEnabled then break end
					local prompt, pos = data.prompt, data.pos
					if prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled and pos then
						root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 1.2), pos)
						if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, pos) end
						task.wait(0.18)
						if prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled then
							local keyCode = prompt.KeyboardKeyCode or Enum.KeyCode.E
							pcall(function() 
								VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game) 
								task.wait(prompt.HoldDuration > 0 and prompt.HoldDuration + 0.05 or 0.02) 
								VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game) 
							end)
							if prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled then 
								pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldBegin() task.wait(math.max(prompt.HoldDuration, 0.02)) prompt:InputHoldEnd() end) 
							end
							local start = os.clock()
							while prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled and os.clock() - start < 0.35 do task.wait(0.02) end
							if prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled then skippedPrompts[prompt] = true end
						end
						task.wait(0.03)
					end
				end
				for part, col in pairs(savedCollides) do if part and part.Parent then part.CanCollide = col end end
				if root and root.Parent then root.CFrame = originalCFrame end
			else
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end
	end
	chestRunning = false
end

local function lootVacuumLoop()
	while lootVacuumEnabled do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		
		if root then
			local workspaceChildren = workspace:GetChildren()
			for i = 1, #workspaceChildren do
				if not lootVacuumEnabled then break end
				local item = workspaceChildren[i]
				local nameLower = string.lower(item.Name)
				
				if nameLower:find("lootbag") or 
				   nameLower:find("elder") or 
				   nameLower:find("diamond") or 
				   nameLower:find("darkness") or 
				   (nameLower:find("chest") and not item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")) then
					pcall(function()
						if item:IsA("BasePart") and not item.Anchored then
							item.CFrame = root.CFrame
						elseif item:IsA("Model") then
							item:PivotTo(root.CFrame)
						end
						local prompt = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
						if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
							fireproximityprompt(prompt)
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end

local function openInventoryLoop()
	while autoOpenEnabled do
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		
		if backpack and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local hasOpenSelection = false
			for _, v in pairs(selectedOpenTypes) do if v then hasOpenSelection = true break end end
			
			local openedThisFrame = 0
			local maxPerFrame = 15
			
			local backpackTools = backpack:GetChildren()
			for i = 1, #backpackTools do
				if openedThisFrame >= maxPerFrame or not autoOpenEnabled then break end
				local tool = backpackTools[i]
				if tool:IsA("Tool") then
					local toolName = string.lower(tool.Name)
					if not hasOpenSelection or selectedOpenTypes[tool.Name] then
						if toolName:find("chest") or toolName:find("diamond") or toolName:find("darkness") then
							openedThisFrame = openedThisFrame + 1
							task.spawn(function()
								pcall(function()
									if tool:FindFirstChild("OpenAll") then
										tool.OpenAll:FireServer()
									elseif tool:FindFirstChild("Open") then
										tool.Open:FireServer(true)
									else
										humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
										tool:Activate()
									end
								end)
							end)
						elseif toolName:find("lootbag") then
							openedThisFrame = openedThisFrame + 1
							for j = 1, 5 do
								task.spawn(function()
									pcall(function()
										humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
										tool:Activate()
									end)
								end)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	end
end

local function npcKillLoop()
	while npcKillEnabled do
		local character = player.Character
		
		pcall(function()
			sethiddenproperty(player, "SimulationRadius", 112412400000)
			sethiddenproperty(player, "MaxSimulationRadius", 112412400000)
		end)

		local hasNpcSelection = false
		for npcName, selected in pairs(selectedNPCTypes) do
			if selected == true then hasNpcSelection = true break end
		end

		local allObjects = workspace:GetDescendants()
		for i = 1, #allObjects do
			local d = allObjects[i]
			if d and d:IsA("Humanoid") and d.Parent and d.Parent ~= character and not checkIgnore(d.Parent) then
				if not hasNpcSelection or selectedNPCTypes[d.Parent.Name] == true then
					if d.Health > 0 then
						pcall(function()
							d.Health = 0
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.3) 
	end
end

local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local rs = game:GetService("RunService")
local jb = 14

local function setup(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local joint = root:WaitForChild("RootJoint")
	local c0 = joint.C0
	local on = false

	local function stop()
		if on then
			rs:UnbindFromRenderStep("backflip")
			on = false
		end
		if joint.Parent then
			joint.C0 = c0
		end
	end

	hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
		if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
			if on then
				stop()
			end
			return
		end
		if new ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return end
		stop()
		on = true
		local md0 = hum.MoveDirection
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local look = Vector3.new(cam.LookVector.X, 0, cam.LookVector.Z).Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(cam.RightVector.X, 0, cam.RightVector.Z).Unit
		local dir
		if md0.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			dir = -Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
		else
			local f = md0:Dot(look)
			local r = md0:Dot(right)
			if math.abs(f) >= math.abs(r) then
				dir = f > 0 and look or -look
			else
				dir = r > 0 and right or -right
			end
		end
		local axis = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis:Cross(dir)).Unit
		local g = workspace.Gravity
		local v = (hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * g * hum.JumpHeight)) + jb
		local dur = math.max(2 * v / g * 0.95, 0.35)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		local boosted = false
		rs:BindToRenderStep("backflip", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
			local a = (os.clock() - t0) / dur
			if a >= 1 or hum.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent then
				stop()
				return
			end
			if not boosted then
				boosted = true
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Vector3.new(0, jb, 0)
			end
			joint.C0 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, a * math.pi * 2) * c0
		end)
	end)
end

if plr.Character then
	task.spawn(setup, plr.Character)
end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(setup)

-- Educational UI Concept for Reset-Safe State Persistence
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Create a ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "PersistentFlightGui"
-- CRUCIAL: Stops Roblox from deleting this UI when you die
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false 
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Main Container Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.4, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
MainFrame.Active = true 
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- ==========================================
-- MOBILE FINGER & MOUSE DRAGGING ENGINE
-- ==========================================
local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale, 
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
        startPos.Y.Scale, 
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)
-- ==========================================

-- Minimize / Maximize Toggle Button
local MinBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 25)
MinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
MinBtn.Text = "-"
MinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 30, 30)
MinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- Flight Toggle Button
local FlightButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
FlightButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 195, 0, 30)
FlightButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
FlightButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FlightButton.Parent = MainFrame

-- Directional Controls Frame
local ControlFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ControlFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 150)
ControlFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
ControlFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ControlFrame.Visible = false
ControlFrame.Parent = MainFrame

-- Helper function to build uniform directional buttons
local function createButton(name, pos, text)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = pos
    btn.Text = text
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Parent = ControlFrame
    return btn
end

-- Layout direction elements
local UpBtn    = createButton("UpBtn",    UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 5),   "Up")
local LeftBtn  = createButton("LeftBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 50),  "Left")
local RightBtn = createButton("RightBtn", UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50), "Right")
local DownBtn  = createButton("DownBtn",  UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 95),  "Down")

-- Global States & Physics Trackers
local flightActive = false
local isMinimized = false
local movementVelocity = nil
local rotationGyro = nil
local MOVEMENT_SPEED = 2 

-- References to the active character (changes when you die)
local currentCharacter = nil
local currentHumanoid = nil
local currentRootPart = nil

-- Core function to enable or disable physics setups
local function updatePhysicsState()
    if not currentCharacter or not currentHumanoid or not currentRootPart then return end
    
    -- Clean up any lingering objects from a previous character life
    if movementVelocity then movementVelocity:Destroy() movementVelocity = nil end
    if rotationGyro then rotationGyro:Destroy() rotationGyro = nil end
    
    if flightActive then
        FlightButton.Text = "DISABLE"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
        if not isMinimized then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = MOVEMENT_SPEED
        
        -- Orient character flat immediately
        local flatTargetCFrame = currentRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        currentRootPart.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame
        
        -- Apply locking forces
        rotationGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        rotationGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4e5, 4e5, 4e5) 
        rotationGyro.D = 100 
        rotationGyro.P = 10000 
        rotationGyro.CFrame = flatTargetCFrame 
        rotationGyro.Parent = currentRootPart
        
        movementVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        movementVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6) 
        movementVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) 
        movementVelocity.Parent = currentRootPart
    else
        FlightButton.Text = "FLY (ENABLE)"
        FlightButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 180)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        
        currentHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        currentRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentRootPart.Position)
    end
end

-- Hook up Character Re-binding loops (Fires every time you respawn)
local function onCharacterAdded(newCharacter)
    currentCharacter = newCharacter
    currentHumanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    currentRootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    -- Instantly enforce the flight/flat physics if it was left ON when you died
    updatePhysicsState()
end

-- Connect to existing character, and listen for future spawns
if LocalPlayer.Character then onCharacterAdded(LocalPlayer.Character) end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

-- Minimize/Maximize UI Logic
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isMinimized = not isMinimized
    if isMinimized then
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 40)
        ControlFrame.Visible = false
        MinBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 200)
        if flightActive then ControlFrame.Visible = true end
        MinBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

-- Manual UI Toggle Button Press Listener
FlightButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    flightActive = not flightActive
    updatePhysicsState()
end)

-- Velocity Controller Direction mapping
local function applyPhysicsVelocity(directionVector)
    if not flightActive or not movementVelocity then return end
    movementVelocity.Velocity = directionVector * MOVEMENT_SPEED
end

-- Button click/tap bindings
UpBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end)
UpBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

DownBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)) end)
DownBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

LeftBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)) end)
LeftBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

RightBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)) end)
RightBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() applyPhysicsVelocity(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) end)
